summary: Adversarial verification of wf/design/phase0.md and wf/design/owner-decisions.md (read-only; git read commands and python3 -I only). Most of the plan's factual base holds. 36 load-bearing claims were re-checked and survived: git state, handoff integrity, committed-foundation lines, board strings and CSS thresholds, final-deliverable counts, and id floors. (a) The starting-point procedure matches reality: 3 branches at 1b090c9, main e8c6a84 without v2/, no remote, no stash, one worktree, 98 uncommitted paths (11 M + 60 Slice-1 ?? + 27 Source Pack ??), no CLAUDE.md, zip SHA-256 9d33f32e…24bf, 178/178 OK, 0 CRLF, no gitignore hits. No step touches the main checkout's working-tree files. The only git write there is the owner-chosen G-1 option A, which is limited to pathspec v2 (71 paths), runs with no active hooks and no CRLF in Slice-1, and leaves the Source Pack untracked. (c) The plan adds no DEMO banner, no account or role selector, no third-party design system and no Slice-1 UI. (d) The B1-10 fix is in DataTable, and its tests sit at the verified 759.98 px thresholds. (e) All foundation conflicts are addressed. (i) The package placement is legal once the proposed matrix edits are made. Six major defects: (1) XS-01/03/04 and the public shell are pulled into Phase 0 against B8-06 and against the owner register (A4(c), P1-01, SC-20), and the stated reason contradicts the plan's own CI-only session seam. (2) The two documents' gate lists disagree: register A1 and A3 are missing from phase0, G-4 is not a true blocker, and G-5 is absent from the register. (3) G-2 bundles decisions the register places in Phase 1 or 3, or marks as needing no authorisation (AD-39, TE-5, TE-1 on XS-01, AD-07). (4) prettier --write/--check conflicts with the byte-identical permission-matrix.json and the vendored board-capture scripts. (5) Turbo test caching lets matrix-driven and handoff-reading gates go stale. (6) The Phase-0 port-level flow suites reach AD-14, AD-38/DV-2 and DV-1/AD-18 with no stated Phase-0 interim, and the documents disagree on DV-1. 13 minor defects follow: unsatisfiable or self-referential acceptance criteria, import-fence and bundling gaps, inconsistent defaults between the two documents, dead-end links, and procedure details.
